components.name: button
components.label: Button
components.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

components.name: card
components.label: Card
components.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

components.name: input
components.label: Input
components.description: Displays a form input field.

components.name: dialog
components.label: Dialog
components.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.

components.name: badge
components.label: Badge
components.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

components.name: form
components.label: Form
components.description: Composable form field primitives — FormField, FormLabel, FormHelperText, and FormMessage.

components.name: spinner
components.label: Spinner
components.description: An animated loading indicator. Supports four sizes and eight color variants.

components.name: skeleton
components.label: Skeleton
components.description: A placeholder that mimics content layout while data loads.

components.name: separator
components.label: Separator
components.description: A thin line that visually divides content. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

components.name: avatar
components.label: Avatar
components.description: Displays a user avatar with image, initials fallback, color variants, status indicators, and group stacking.

components.name: accordion
components.label: Accordion
components.description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections with animated open/close and three visual variants.

components.name: progress
components.label: Progress
components.description: A progress bar with size, color, striped, and indeterminate variants.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.label: Breadcrumb
components.description: A navigation trail showing the user's location in a hierarchy. Supports custom separators, collapsed items, and framework-agnostic links.

components.name: pagination
components.label: Pagination
components.description: Controls for navigating between pages of content. Supports active states, ellipsis for large ranges, and framework-agnostic links.

components.name: sidebar
components.label: Sidebar
components.description: A collapsible vertical navigation panel with icon-rail mode, grouped links, badges, and a composable header/footer.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.label: Navigation Menu
components.description: A horizontal navigation bar with animated dropdown panels. Supports grouped links, rich content, and keyboard navigation.

components.name: stepper
components.label: Stepper
components.description: A step-by-step progress indicator. Composable pieces — indicator, title, description, separator — for horizontal and vertical layouts.

components.name: alert
components.label: Alert
components.description: An inline banner for success, warning, info, or error feedback. Auto icon per variant, optional title, and a dismiss button.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.label: Alert Dialog
components.description: A modal confirmation dialog that interrupts the user. Destructive/warning/info levels and a loading action button.

components.name: toast
components.label: Toast
components.description: Toast notifications powered by Sonner — success, error, warning, and info helpers with rich colors.

components.name: tooltip
components.label: Tooltip
components.description: A popup label shown on hover or focus. Configurable side, delay, arrow, and size.

components.name: popover
components.label: Popover
components.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger element.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.label: Dropdown Menu
components.description: A menu of actions opened from a trigger. Supports icons, descriptions, submenus, and checkbox/radio items.

components.name: sheet
components.label: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from any edge, with size variants.

components.name: select
components.label: Select
components.description: A dropdown select with sizes, error state, and a clearable selection.

components.name: checkbox
components.label: Checkbox
components.description: A checkbox with sizes, color variants, error state, and a CheckboxGroup for grouped context.

components.name: radio-group
components.label: Radio Group
components.description: A set of radio buttons with sizes, colors, error state, and horizontal or vertical orientation.

components.name: switch
components.label: Switch
components.description: A toggle switch with color variants and a SwitchField composition helper.

components.name: textarea
components.label: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text input with sizes, error state, a character counter, and auto-resize.

components.name: tabs
components.label: Tabs
components.description: Tabbed navigation with pills, line, and card variants plus icon and badge slots.

components.name: kbd
components.label: Kbd
components.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut. For hotkeys, command palettes, and shortcut hints.

components.name: combobox
components.label: Combobox
components.description: A searchable single-select dropdown with keyboard navigation, clearable selection, and sizes. Built on Popover.

components.name: table
components.label: Table
components.description: Composable table primitives — header, body, row, head, cell, footer, caption — for building styled and data tables.
